instruments.interpretation: The client reported frequent everyday attention difficulties.
The parent reported fewer attention difficulties at home.
The teacher reported frequent classroom attention difficulties; this uses a different metric from the client scale.
The clinician noted stronger visual reasoning than performance on tasks holding several instructions in mind.
